title: Sugar
overview: محقق خاص غامض يكابد وساوس شخصية بينما يحقّق في اختفاء الحفيدة الحبيبة لأحد منتجي "هوليوود".

ai_content.desc_en: Sugar: A gripping drama series. An enigmatic private detective, battling personal demons, investigates the disappearance of a beloved granddaughter of a Hollywood producer. Will he uncover the truth or will his doubts hinder his progress?
